services.name: Party package
services.desc: This breathtaking 40-acre estate can be all yours for your wedding or event. At the center of our vineyard lies our one-of-a-kind Tasting Room, with a magnificent deck (or dance floor) that sits inches above the Koi-stocked lake. For larger groups, this venue takes center stage for cocktail hour, reception, or both. The Tasting Room is also perfect for smaller gatherings, such as private wine dinners, anniversary or birthday parties, and of course corporate entertaining. Another option is tucked away near our winery, just a short stroll up a gentle slope from the Tasting Room. This is our pergola option that is shaded by our oldest oak tree on the property. Paso Robles is short for El Paso

services.name: Bianchi Tasting Room
services.desc: Experience the culmination of three generations of passion and craftsmanship at our Paso Robles Tasting Room. We proudly pour award-winning wines that reflect the unique terroir of our family’s 40-acre estate-best enjoyed in one of the most scenic settings on the Central Coast. Nestled in the heart of the vineyard, our tasting room offers sweeping views of rolling vines, a serene koi lake, and inviting indoor and outdoor spaces. Relax on the patio or unwind inside, where natural light fills an elegant, welcoming atmosphere. blurb: Guests can enjoy wine tastings at the Paso Robles estate tasting room with vineyard views and dog-friendly patios, or at the Laguna Beach tasting room with ocean views and an intimate setting. The winery offers wine club memberships with various shipment options and discounts. Lodging is available at the Vineyard House, a 3-bedroom home on the estate overlooking a lake.
